# pgsid query analysis tests — `sqlc-corpus/cases/`

Every case keeps sqlc's schema, query, configuration, and extracted expected
IR verdicts together. Optional pgsid-owned data.sql supplies executable witness
rows; optional adjudication.json records conclusions about observed
disagreements.

Do not edit an upstream-owned file to make pgsid pass. Fix the engine, record a
PostgreSQL-backed adjudication, or refresh the pinned corpus according to the
root provenance document.

## Project layout

    sqlc-corpus/cases/
    └─ [case]/               (zero or more, any name)
       │
       ├─ adjudication.json  an optional PostgreSQL-backed disposition of sqlc
       │                     and pgsid disagreements (optional)
       │
       ├─ data.sql           optional pgsid-owned witness rows for one borrowed
       │                     case (optional)
       │
       ├─ expected.json      sqlc's extracted per-query inference verdicts
       │                     (required)
       │
       ├─ query.sql          the query vendored with one sqlc test case
       │                     (required)
       │
       ├─ schema.sql         the schema vendored with one sqlc test case
       │                     (required)
       │
       ├─ sqlc.json          an optional sqlc case configuration (optional)
       │
       └─ sqlc.yaml          an optional sqlc case configuration (optional)

## `[case]/adjudication.json` — an optional PostgreSQL-backed disposition of sqlc and pgsid disagreements

Record only conclusions supported by this case witness data and keep adjudicatedAgainst aligned with the sqlc release being judged.

## `[case]/data.sql` — optional pgsid-owned witness rows for one borrowed case

Keep witness data separate from the borrowed sqlc files and choose rows that adjudicate actual result contracts.

## `[case]/expected.json` — sqlc's extracted per-query inference verdicts

Regenerate this upstream-derived verdict with the pinned sqlc extractor; do not hand-edit it into agreement with pgsid.

## `[case]/query.sql` — the query vendored with one sqlc test case

Keep this file identical to the pinned upstream sqlc case.

## `[case]/schema.sql` — the schema vendored with one sqlc test case

Keep this file identical to the pinned upstream sqlc case.

## `[case]/sqlc.json` — an optional sqlc case configuration

Keep this file identical to the pinned upstream sqlc case.

## `[case]/sqlc.yaml` — an optional sqlc case configuration

Keep this file identical to the pinned upstream sqlc case.
